title: The turbo-config input audit of @tracy/ds-slot#test:ci covers the fleet IMAGE_TAGS its stand-image suites read
steps: Trace the ds-slot suites test/stand-images.test.mjs and test/stand-version.test.mjs with scripts/ci/trace-reads.mjs.
Ask Turbo (turbo run test:ci --filter=@tracy/ds-slot --dry=json) which files it hashes for @tracy/ds-slot#test:ci.
Run coverageProblems from scripts/ci/turbo-setup.mjs (the audit of turbo-setup.mjs --check) over those reads, that hash and the task's turbo.json inputs.
expect: Both suites are green and their traced reads include packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/web/IMAGE_TAGS.
The audit reports no problem; before the fix it reported "@tracy/ds-slot#test:ci: its suite reads packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/web/IMAGE_TAGS, which is not among the task's inputs".
evidence: build check (tests packages) red on every PR built on develop after #558: turbo-config: @tracy/ds-slot#test:ci: its suite reads packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/web/IMAGE_TAGS, which is not among the task's inputs
fence: The task's turbo.json inputs, judged by the same coverageProblems audit the turbo-config gate runs
